messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU pool eu-west-1 is saturated. queue_length=1240 (>threshold=200), autoscaler_state=THROTTLED, scale_attempts=3

Alex (oncall): Ack. jumping in. bridge: +1-555-ALT-404, chan:#incident-bridge

Miguel (eng-runtime): Initial look: autoscaler logs show 'scale_limit_reached' for pool-id=gpu-euw-2 and provider returned 429 on node create attempts. Also seeing high KV-cache miss rate -> more work per request.

Jen (sre): Is this new tenant burst or system-wide? Any tenant ids in logs?

Miguel (eng-runtime): Found a hot tenant id=tenant-8421 with surge of batched evals. spike pattern: looped job that re-sends 128 reqs/s. Query samples:
```
POST /v1/generate  tenant=8421  payload_size=1.2k
```

Lina (customer-success): I'm getting customer reports of timeouts and 5xx from multiple EU customers. Opening CS ticket and pinging top 3 customers.

Ravi (ops): Provider quota shows we're at our soft cap for instances in eu-west-1: usage=96 of 100. Autoscaler max_nodes=100, but pool max for this plan is 12 nodes. Confusing.

Alex (oncall): tl;dr: pool hitting configured pool_max_nodes and provider quota. Immediate mitigations?

Miguel (eng-runtime): Suggested mitigations, ordered:
1) Apply tenant soft-rate-limit on tenant-8421 to 20 rps (fast)
2) Fall back affected routes to smaller model (gpt-small) to reduce GPU time
3) Manually increase pool max_nodes to 18 (requires deploy approval)
4) If provider quota is blocking, move scheduler to eu-west-2 for overflow

Jen (sre): I'll take tenant throttling + fallback. Alex, can you request manual pool increase with product owner now?

Alex (oncall): Requesting pool bump via infra-request ticket: infra#12345. Pinged infra leads. Also contacting provider to request temporary quota bump.

deploy-bot: Throttle middleware config push queued. diff:
```
PATCH /config/tenant-rates
- tenant 8421: max_rps: 200
+ tenant 8421: max_rps: 20
```

Miguel (eng-runtime): I'm prepping a model-route weight change: route /v1/generate -> gpt-small (weight 0.6) for tenants with >200ms per-token.

Jen (sre): Executed tenant throttling. Confirmed connections for tenant-8421 dropped to ~18 rps. Queue length started drifting down. Monitoring.

Lina (customer-success): Notifying affected customers with temporary mitigation note. No major data loss, just latency and 503s earlier.

Ravi (ops): Provider granted emergency quota +10 nodes in eu-west-1 (temporary). Manual pool_max_nodes increased to 18. Autoscaler resumed scaling.

Alex (oncall): Confirming: queue now 180, p95 latency back to acceptable range. Status: partial mitigation, page remains open while we stabilise.

Miguel (eng-runtime): Root cause shortlisting: tenant runaway batch job + autoscaler config mismatch (pool hard max < needed headroom) + provider soft quota. Also no per-tenant queue alert triggered.

Jen (sre): Action items (assigned):
- Miguel: implement per-tenant queue alerts (alert when one tenant >30% of pool queue) - due EOD
- Ravi: coordinate with infra to adjust default pool_max_nodes vs provider quota and document overflow region - due next week
- Alex: lead postmortem write-up with customer impact summary - due 48h
- Lina: follow-up comms for top affected customers - ongoing

Miguel (eng-runtime): Quick note: added short-lived fallback policy to route ~10% traffic to CPU-only fallback path for embedders.

Alex (oncall): Handoff to Jen for overnight. Jen, you own until incident resolved/pm completed.

Jen (sre): Taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring and escalate if queue trend reverses. If autoscaler errors >3 in 15m, reopen pager. :eyes:

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to Sev3 -> mitigated. playbook: capacity-exhaustion -> start postmortem when incident closed.

Lina (customer-success): Customers updated. No SLA credits requested yet. Will advise Product if any escalate.

Alex (oncall): Closing active paging; leaving thread open for postmortem notes. Good job team. :tada:
